summary: There is no monospace face (ADR 0011). --ui-font-mono and --ui-text-code-sm are removed from the token contract, and SeedTypography.fontMono is removed from the seed shape so a brand author cannot reintroduce one. Code content is set in the body face and distinguished by surface treatment; numeric alignment uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Monospace families move from the licensing allowlist to its restricted map, so any mono stack in registry/, packages/ or apps/ now fails pnpm check:licensing with an explanatory message. Verified: every node on the Paper Handover page is Aspekta — no mono, Geist, Saans, Manrope or General Sans remains.

migration.manual: No consumers exist yet. Any future code/pre styling uses --ui-text-body-sm with a bg-sunken ground and --ui-radius-sm rather than a mono family; data tables use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
